NHK Spring.why: Makes HDD suspensions; demand for suspensions for high-capacity HDDs is expanding on AI-related and data-center storage demand and the company is adding suspension capacity in Japan, overseas and Thailand.
NHK Spring.evidence: NHK Spring release 09-17-2026: about 50 oku yen additional investment to add HDD suspension lines in Japan and overseas to meet current demand growth centered on AI-related applications and data centers.

players.product: HDD suspensions (Disk Drive Suspension business) for high-capacity HDDs used in AI-related applications and data centers

quarterly_data.signal: NHK Spring decided to increase HDD suspension production capacity to meet the current rise in demand, centered on AI-related applications and data centers: about JPY 5 billion (50 oku yen) of additional investment across the DDS (Disk Drive Suspension) business to add HDD suspension production lines at multiple sites in Japan and overseas, with the lines starting operation sequentially from 2027. The amount is not included in the roughly 350 oku yen investment plan announced on July 16, 2026 for the Thailand site.
quarterly_data.figure: about 50 oku yen additional investment; operation from 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Company: data storage demand is increasing with the expansion of AI-related applications and data centers; HDD capacities are rising and the number of suspensions mounted per HDD tends to increase, so demand for HDD suspensions, mainly for high-capacity HDDs, is currently expanding.
